title: Text from Tomás B. (7 West): Call Light and a Misrouted Gown Cart

bubbles.text: Charge, the med-surg gentleman still at the end of 7 West keeps hitting his call light. Cable TV went out and he wants someone to pull up the weather on his phone and prop it up so he can watch the eye.
He's fine otherwise, just upset. 3rd time in 10 min.

Also a cart just came off the elevator labeled "NICU — 7W." 40 ADULT gowns and bath basins. Do we keep it? Supply says they're sending everything up wherever there's room. It's parked in the hall by the holding area.

instructorNote: This is a noise inject. The NICU Charge Nurse should hand the call light to the 7 West med-surg staff and send the cart back by stairs or a later elevator slot through the House Supervisor, without using a patient-movement elevator. NICU nurses should stay on the hourly early warning scores. Watch whether NICU staff get pulled away from the infants.
